description: Web search, URL discovery, scraping & extraction with agent-browser and search providers
name: io.github.yokingma/one-search-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Search provider to use (searxng, duckduckgo, bing, tavily, google, zhipu, exa, bocha, ydc, local)
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: API URL for SearXNG (required if using searxng provider), or Google Custom Search Engine ID for google
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key for search provider (required for tavily, bing, google, zhipu, exa, bocha)
environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: You.com API key for ydc provider
environmentVariables.name: YDC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Allow browser-backed tools to access private, loopback, and link-local network targets when set to true
environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK
